title: applied-ml-weekly-notes-2026-06-02
content:
Applied ML weekly research notes - 2026-06-02

Attendees: Priya Desai (owner), Evan Wu, Liam O'Connor, Sofia Martinez, Rachel Kim
Meeting length: 45m
Location: Zoom / #applied-ml

Agenda:
- Quick sync: quantization experiment status (GPQT/NG/Q4-bit profiles)
- Eval runs on internal benchmark suite (MMLU, HellaSwag, code generation subset)
- Model onboarding checklist: llama-2-13b-chat variant + mistral-7b-instruct smoke tests
- Action items and next steps

Notes:
1) Quantization experiments (Evan, Priya)
- Ran GPTQ pipeline on llama-2-13b-chat using A100-80GB. Config: per-channel, 4-bit NF4-like, GPTQ 1-pass.
- Key result: 4-bit GPTQ model shows ~1.8x throughput on our inference harness compared to fp16 baseline for 512-token prompts (measured on dedicated benchmark runner). Median token latency down from 42ms -> 24ms under baseline load.
- Quality: internal perplexity on heldout reddit+wikitext increased by ~0.9% relative (acceptable threshold = 2.5%). MMLU accuracy drop: 0.7 percentage points on average (baseline 74.3% -> quantized 73.6%).
- Noted instability when enabling 128k KV cache + quantized weights: occasional generation stalls after long context (~>32k tokens) on H100 tests. Hypothesis: KV cache alignment + int8->fp32 dequant path race. Evan to open a repro PR with a minimal script.
- Next: try hybrid approach (first N layers fp16, rest 4-bit) to recover 0.4-0.6pp of accuracy with ~1.6x throughput. Target: hybrid config candidate for Redwood Optimize suggestions.

2) Quantization toolchain updates (Liam)
- Merged support for token-aligned rounding in GPTQ impl (PR#87). This reduced some decode-time artifacts on multi-byte tokens. Initial smoke tests pass.
- CI: added a short quantized inference unit test in model-quantize repo; still flaky on CI GPU matrix (intermittent OOM for 80k-context runs). Action: reduce test context to 8k and add a heavy-integration gated job.

3) Eval runs and metrics (Sofia)
- Completed batch eval for 6 quantized variants across internal suite (MMLU, HellaSwag, GSM8K subset, HumanEval small). Summary: most delta within tolerance for conversation workloads; code generation shows slightly larger regressions on top-k sampling (avg accuracy -1.5pp).
- Observed that temperature and sampling config tuning recovers ~0.6pp on HumanEval for quantized models. Add to automated eval pipeline: run small hyperparam sweep (top_p=0.85-0.95, temp=0.2-0.6) for code tasks.
- Regression alert thresholds discussed: for hosted API tier we allow up to 1.0pp drop on downstream evals depending on workload; anything above triggers rollback/canary hold. Document to update in Confluence (Sofia).

4) Model onboarding (Rachel + Priya)
- Onboarding checklist additions: tokenization edge-cases, special token mapping, conversation format compatibility, pre/post-processing validation, KV-cache smoke runs, perf profile upload.
- Tested onboarding for mistral-7b-instruct candidate: tokenization differences for some legacy special tokens found ("<|system|>" mapping). Created conversion shim in tokenizer wrapper.
- Llama-2-13b-chat variant: validated logits stability between reference and our runtime for first 1024 tokens (mean L2 diff < 1e-5). Good to proceed to quantization stage.
- Required docs: add model-card note on memory/latency tradeoffs for quantized variants (Priya + Rachel).

5) Operational notes / SRE impact (Priya)
- Observed increased GPU memory fragmentation when running many simultaneous quantized sessions (likely due to our allocator + dequant buffers). SRE to add a monitoring dashboard for fragmentation metrics and OOM rates for quantized endpoints. (SRE ticket: SRE-590).
- Canary rollout plan: 5% traffic -> monitor latency, error-rate, and eval probes (we already have eval webhook). If metrics stable for 24h promote to 25%.

Open issues / blockers:
- Repro for long-context stall on quantized + KV cache (blocking hybrid rollout).
- CI flakes on GPU matrix for large-context quantized tests.
- Need final decision on default quantization profile for hosted-api (4-bit nf4 vs hybrid) before next deploy window (target 2026-06-15).

Action items (owner - due):
- Evan: create minimal repro for long-context stall + attach logs (2026-06-04)
- Liam: tweak CI quantize tests & add gated heavy-integration job (2026-06-05)
- Sofia: add hyperparameter sweep to eval pipeline for code tasks and update Confluence regression thresholds (2026-06-07)
- Rachel & Priya: draft model-card notes for quantized variants and onboarding checklist update (2026-06-09)
- Priya: create SRE ticket SRE-590 and dashboard template for quantized fragmentation metrics (2026-06-04)

Notes to self / rough ideas:
- Consider adding a cheap bloom-filter style LRU for prefix caching to reduce repeated KV re-computation under quantized models. Might recover some latency.
- Explore mixed-precision kernels on A100 vs H100: H100 shows slightly less speedup for 4-bit due to specialized INT8 kernels availability — schedule microbench next week.

Decisions made:
- Keep progressing with 4-bit GPTQ candidate in staging; do not push to hosted until hybrid config experiments complete.
- CI change approved: reduce heavy test contexts in unit matrix and gate large-context tests to integration only.

Next meeting: 2026-06-09, 10:30am PT
